name: Arló (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Arló (a yellow shield with a red eagle and a blue base) within a green wreath, below a scroll inscribed ARLÓ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Arló arms with wreath and scroll
